launches.title: Clodo - Vibe GTM
launches.tagline: Execute outbound at the speed of thought.
launches.body:
# Find your next customers with just a prompt on Clodo. Try it now!

<https://youtu.be/WUqOqtYAhSM>

Vibe GTM is here. From founders in the current batch to GTM teams at the fastest growing AI-era companies, users are setting Clodo loose to find: 

“data platform decision makers at companies spending more than $1M/year on data lake reads” 

“best targets who will be attending CES“

“AI tool buyers at the top 40 industrial general contractors (ie. fabs/data centers)”

“people who need our product NOW” 

Try it out right now at [clodo.ai](https://clodo.ai)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96826&key=user_uploads/353032/080add04-5ee1-4193-addd-2ce4f61a428f)

### **HOW IT WORKS** 

**Just from a prompt, Clodo prospects and consolidates signals from everywhere**, be it hiring activity, blogs, social media activity, public records, and so much more **to derive the highest quality lead lists you’ll ever find anywhere.** 

Prospects that fit your exact criteria. 

Prospects that want to buy. 

Contact enrichments included as well. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96826&key=user_uploads/353032/d3f94b5b-f7fa-4c53-956d-f953bb962823)

### **TASTEFUL OUTBOUND ON AUTOPILOT**

**Clodo not only finds you prospects who are willing to listen, Clodo figures out what exactly to say to them.** 

It’s going to be a rough decade for templated sequences. Prospects can tell when they are on the receiving end of a “Hello {{first_name}}, Really impressed by your work as {{job}} at {{company}}”. 

Instead, Clodo automatically plans and executes tasteful, personalized outbound campaigns to each prospect all on your behalf. No em dashes, no AI slop prose, just normal sounding emails that lead to better conversion. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96826&key=user_uploads/353032/37caf209-238b-43f3-b04b-d19e283e3cf0)

### **SELLING: A Resolution for 2026**

In 2026, STOP WASTING TIME sifting through the dozens of tools and websites to find qualified prospects who are actually in need of what you’re selling. And definitely DO NOT BURN CASH on templated “Hello {{first_name}}” sequences to the abyss. 

In 2026, vibe GTM :) 

Got a super specific use case in mind or any questions/concerns? We’re at [founders@clodo.ai](mailto:founders@clodo.ai) \
Happy to chat more: <https://calendly.com/clodoai/clodo-ai>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96826&key=user_uploads/353032/f7c45b00-48e9-4701-8be6-8d90878a5611)

Here’s to a great 2026. Happy selling!
